annotations.title: Check a crypto wallet for risk

description: Returns a read-only risk assessment of a cryptocurrency wallet address. It never moves funds or initiates transactions. Provide `address`; the chain (EVM, Solana, TON, or Bitcoin) is detected from the address format automatically. Returns a risk level of CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW, or unknown, with the specific sanctions, scam, drainer, and phishing flags behind it. A verdict of unknown means nothing is known against the address; it does not mean the address is safe.

address.description: Wallet address to screen. Chain is auto-detected.
